selection_rationale: Example payload for no-render workflow validation.
core_concept: A single elegant portrait transitions into a gentle camera move.

lora.name: Example Character Anima
lora.trigger_analysis: Keep the character trigger in each T2I prompt.

i2v.prompt: A close portrait holds steady as the subject turns toward camera; a slow push-in reveals a gentle smile while fabric and hair move naturally in the ambient air.
i2v.negative: still image, bad quality, subtitles, text, watermark, logo, static, blur

identity_anchors: The same clearly adult example character remains visually consistent.
environment_anchors: Lighting and room layout remain stable.

segments.positive_prompt: The adult subject begins the ordered turn while the camera starts its slow push-in.
The same motion continues without stopping as the adult subject completes the turn and smiles.

t2i.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, highres, realistic portrait, example character, soft directional light, detailed skin, looking at viewer
t2i.negative: worst quality, low quality, sketch, text, watermark, logo
